trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is no extra task behind it: finish the story, the 100% checklist and the cleanup, and it unlocks by itself.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order; the platinum unlocks automatically with the last one.
Use the Roadmap tab to work in order: story first (60-80 hours), then the 100% checklist (about 100 hours), then Strangers & Freaks and cleanup (about 10 hours).
PowerPyx puts the whole run at about 200 hours and Push Square at 300 hours or more, so treat it as a long project, not a weekend.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this unlocks naturally in the first hour of play; there is nothing to prepare or look up.
steps: Start a new game and play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end.
No side task is needed: the trophy pops when the mission completes.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Play the chapter's missions in order; before the chapter ends, do the one thing that can be missed: Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).
steps: Play through Chapter 1's missions until the chapter closes.
Before leaving Chapter 1, complete the balcony meditation with Lucia (after the mission Down to Earth) — it is the run's only possibly missable trophy moment.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of the chapter; there is no mission replay.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. The final meditation spot only opens once both characters can play together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — keep meditating as new spots appear.
steps: Play through Chapter 2's missions until the chapter closes.
After Coffee Break, both characters can roam together, which is when the last meditation spot becomes reachable (see Positive Mental Attitude).

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. By now the Key Cloner from the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs is in hand, which is also what the Capital Offense trophy needs.
steps: Play through Chapter 3's missions until the chapter closes.
Take the optional character missions as they appear; quest givers who vanish mid-story return later in free roam.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. One chapter remains after this; keep a manual save at the chapter boundary, since missions cannot be replayed.
steps: Play through Chapter 4's missions until the chapter closes.
Save manually at the start and end of the chapter.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the final mission. Finishing it opens free roam and the 100% Completion Checklist (Touch Pad, then Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), which is where the rest of the platinum run happens.
steps: Finish the story's final mission.
After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see everything still to do.
Everything needed for the checklist stays available in free roam.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Breakfast Run. It comes up during the story, so just keep playing the missions in order.
steps: Play the story until the mission Breakfast Run appears, then complete it.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the heist mission The Cartel Heist. It is part of the campaign, so it unlocks as the story reaches it.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears, then complete it.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Child's Play. It unlocks during the campaign with no extra requirement.
steps: Play the story until the mission Child's Play appears, then complete it.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Headliners. It unlocks during the campaign with no extra requirement.
steps: Play the story until the mission Headliners appears, then complete it.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. It unlocks during the campaign; the similarly named Catch Me If You Can is a separate free-roam trophy at the same airport.
steps: Play the story until the mission VCIA Takedown appears, then complete it.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy for the mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks during the campaign with no extra requirement.
steps: Play the story until the mission Operation Savage Glory appears, then complete it.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy: reach 100% on the in-game checklist. The checklist only opens after the story (Touch Pad, then Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) and it is lenient — PowerPyx calls it closer to 60% true completion, with only some things needed in full.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the full list.
Clear the lines that need everything: all robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests (PowerPyx).
For the partial lines, hit the checklist's numbers, not the game's totals: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 challenges.
Push Square's 100% checklist page lists every line; the Roadmap tab here summarises the counts.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind. Push Square counts 397 stunts in the game, across stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps, so you need a little over half of them; the 100% checklist wants 300.
steps: Do stunts as you travel: jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count.
Check progress at any time under Touch Pad, then Progress, then Activities, then Stunts (Push Square).
Discovered stunt spots show on the map under Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots.
250 pops the trophy; keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once. Push Square counts 9 activity types in the game, so sample one of each — a race, a fishing trip, an arcade game, a shooting range and the rest — rather than grinding one of them.
steps: Play one round of each activity type you come across: racing, fishing, arcade, shooting range, drone racing and the others.
Push Square counts 9 activity types; the trophy pops when the last type is tried once.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every shooting-range challenge — 42 of them, per the PS5 tracker counts. PowerPyx rates the gold medals as not too difficult, and every range is required for the 100% checklist too, so this is not skippable work.
steps: Visit the shooting ranges and work through all 42 challenges.
Aim for gold on each; a lower medal means coming back to that challenge.
PowerPyx notes the golds are not too difficult — steady aim beats rushing.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations. Every location is required for the 100% checklist as well, so treat this as checklist work, not a side detour.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone races around Leonida and win one at each location.
PowerPyx lists drone races among the few tasks the 100% checklist needs in full, so none can be skipped.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different is the key word: re-running the same race does not count, so work through the race list across Leonida instead of farming one favourite.
steps: Enter races around Leonida and win 20 distinct ones.
Track which races you have won; repeats add nothing to the count.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the activities that also feeds the story (the Gone Fishing mission), so the mechanics will already be familiar by the time Cal's challenge comes up.
steps: Take on Cal's fishing challenge when it is offered.
Out-fish Cal to win the challenge and pop the trophy.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it to the end — a single completion is all it takes, and it also counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in Leonida.
Play one arcade game through to its end.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's quest line through to his final mission. Side-character quest givers can go quiet mid-story, but PowerPyx confirms every trophy-related quest giver is available again in free roam after the story.
steps: Take Andy's missions as they appear and follow his strand to its final mission.
If Andy goes unavailable during the story, carry on — he returns in free roam after the credits.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's quest line through to his final mission. PowerPyx notes Kenton specifically as a quest giver who can be temporarily unavailable during the story — he comes back later, so do not worry if his missions pause.
steps: Take Kenton's missions as they appear and follow his strand to its final mission.
If Kenton goes quiet mid-story, continue the campaign; he is available again in free roam.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's quest line through to his final mission. Like the other side characters, Billy's strand can be completed after the story in free roam if it is not finished during the campaign.
steps: Take Billy's missions as they appear and follow his strand to its final mission.
Any unfinished Billy missions can be done in free roam after the credits.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Not every side questline counts — PowerPyx was still confirming exactly which strands qualify — so work through the stranger missions you find and check the count as you go.
steps: Find stranger missions across the state and complete whole strands, not single missions.
Count your completed strands; 8 are needed, and they can all be finished after the story.
If a strand does not move the count, it is one of the non-qualifying ones — move on to another stranger.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's quest line through to his final mission. Randy is also tied to the Key Cloner job in Chapter 3 (Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs), which unlocks the Capital Offense trophy, so his strand is worth starting early.
steps: Take Randy's missions as they appear and follow his strand to its final mission.
Complete the Chapter 3 job Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs for Randy to obtain the Key Cloner.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's quest line through to his final mission. As with the other side characters, any unfinished Tyrone missions can be completed in free roam after the story.
steps: Take Tyrone's missions as they appear and follow his strand to its final mission.
Any unfinished Tyrone missions can be done in free roam after the credits.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The run's only possibly missable trophy. There are 18 meditation spots at 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as +2. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations.
steps: CHAPTER 1 WARNING: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning. She says she is going to meditate, then walks to the balcony — follow her and choose Accept. PowerPyx calls this the one missable meditation.
That balcony session raises the counter by 1 but is not listed as a meditation spot, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required — do it anyway.
Meditate at every spot with both characters; the last spot only opens once both can play together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.
For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so this trophy is stricter than the checklist — all 18 count.
Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 1: there is no mission replay, so a skipped balcony meditation cannot be redone on the same save.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are among the few tasks the 100% checklist needs in full, so his whole strand matters — not just this one hunt. Studying animals through binoculars (100 of 255 for the checklist) is separate work that pairs well with hunting trips.
steps: Take Bret's hunting quests and follow his strand.
Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for — his quests must all be finished for the 100% checklist.
While out hunting, study animals with the binoculars: 100 of 255 count toward 100%.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game and the 100% checklist needs 15 of them, so this trophy is an early milestone on a much longer collection: finish 3 sets, then keep going to 15.
steps: Collect cards across Leonida and complete any 3 full sets.
Push Square confirms 18 sets exist and 15 full sets feed the 100% checklist.
Track sets under Progress, then Collections.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations. Scan as you travel from the start of the game — KeenGamer lists 100 WAiNK locations among the 100% checklist's collectible lines — and the trophy will pop long before the checklist is done.
steps: Open the WAiNK app and scan unfamiliar locations as you pass them.
Make scanning a habit during the story; progress counts toward the 100% checklist from the start.
100 scanned locations pops the trophy.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 challenges in total and the 100% checklist needs 70 of them, so this trophy lands on the way to the harder target — and the 10 hardest challenges can be skipped entirely.
steps: Work through the challenges list, starting with the easiest types.
50 completed pops the trophy; keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist.
PowerPyx confirms you may skip the 10 hardest challenges and still reach 100%.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. It becomes possible once Jason and Lucia can roam together, and the partner has to be with you when the heat is lost.
steps: Play with your partner alongside you and raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight, stay out of the search area and escape with your partner still with you.
A quiet stretch of countryside makes the escape easier than downtown Vice City.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the wanted level ever dropping. The chain breaks if the heat is lost between robberies, so pick three close shops and move fast between them.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first, then go straight to the second and third without losing your wanted level in between.
If the wanted level drops, the chain resets — start the three again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scan them with the WAiNK app as you find them. There are 277 base-model vehicles in the game and the 100% checklist needs 200, so 100 is the halfway mark on a longer scan.
steps: Scan every unfamiliar vehicle you pass with the WAiNK app.
100 discovered vehicles pops the trophy; keep scanning to 200 for the 100% checklist.
PowerPyx confirms only 200 of 277 vehicles are needed for 100%, so rare models can be skipped.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies bunch together — a robbery or a gang shootout — then trigger Combat Focus once several targets are in view.
steps: Find a fight where at least 5 enemies are close together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 of them before it ends.
If only 3 or 4 drop, reload the attempt and try a busier fight.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Take a plane that is not part of a mission and get it airborne from the airport, outside any scheduled flight.
steps: Go to VCIA, the airport, outside a mission.
Get into a plane and take off — an unscheduled departure, not a mission flight.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and drive it. A video guide shows the tanks at Mile Zero Air Station, the military base on the island south-west of the map: climb into a Hauners Rhino, drive around, and the trophy pops in about 25 seconds.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the military base on the south-west island.
Get into a Hauners Rhino tank — by car or by boat, as the video guide shows — and drive it around.
The trophy pops after about 25 seconds in the tank.
Save manually first: the base is guarded and your wanted level will climb fast.

sources.name: YouTube — How To Get The Tank In GTA 6

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm, and out before anyone spots the robbery.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Rob it without being detected — if an alarm goes up or staff spot you, leave and try another store.
A manual save before the attempt saves a retry if it goes loud.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. KeenGamer counts 8 bank-vault robberies among the 100% checklist's robbery lines, so the 5 for this trophy are part of that longer job — every vault counts twice.
steps: Find bank vaults and rob them one at a time, escaping after each.
5 vaults robbed and escaped pops the trophy.
Keep going to 8 vaults: the 100% checklist needs all of them (KeenGamer).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — stop one, crack it open, take the cash and lose the cops.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road and stop it.
Rob the truck, then escape the wanted level.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida. This fills in naturally while doing the other exploration trophies — scanning 100 WAiNK locations, discovering vehicles, finding card sets — but check the map for any region never visited.
steps: Travel through every region of Leonida, including the islands and the far counties.
Pair it with the WAiNK and vehicle scans so no trip is wasted.
Check the map for fog or unvisited regions and mop them up in free roam.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. KeenGamer counts 39 gang operations among the 100% checklist's robbery lines, so this trophy is one gang each on the way to all 39.
steps: Find the gangs' illegal operations around the state.
Rob one operation for each gang.
Keep robbing operations to 39 in total for the 100% checklist (KeenGamer).

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. It is a small moment, not a mission: go to the beachfront, order a cocktail and take in the view.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a bar with a view of the water.
Order and enjoy a cocktail there.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. A video guide shows it only works with that specific blue Banshee, and only after the Key Cloner from Chapter 3's Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs.
steps: First finish Chapter 3's mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (steal the Zorrusso for Randy) to obtain the Key Cloner.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and find the blue Banshee.
Use the Key Cloner to get into the Banshee, then drive forward straight through the showroom window.
The trophy pops shortly after you are out on the street — it is slightly delayed, and it only unlocks from this blue Banshee.

sources.name: YouTube — GTA 6 Capital Offense Trophy Guide

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Go bowling there and complete the follow-through the trophy names — a full game at that alley.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl a full game and follow through to the end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose official description is deliberately vague — 'a partnership with mass appeal'. Other trophy lists treat it as a story moment that unlocks while playing the campaign, and no guide has yet published a separate confirmed method, so play the story and do not hunt for it separately.
steps: Play through the story; this is listed by other trophy lists as a story trophy that pops during the campaign.
No separate method has been confirmed by any guide yet — if it has not popped by the finale, check the guides again before hunting.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy about choices made during the story. Other trophy lists treat it as a campaign trophy that unlocks as choices accumulate; there is no confirmed single trigger, so keep playing and making the story's choices.
steps: Play through the story and make the choices the campaign offers.
No single confirmed trigger has been published — it is listed as a story trophy by other trophy lists.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Honestly unknown. The official description only says 'Second time's the charm', and KeenGamer lists this as a hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method. No guide has yet confirmed how it pops, so this entry invents no method — check the cited guides again after more of the game is mapped.
steps: No confirmed method exists yet — the description's hint is that a second attempt at something is involved.
Do not chase guesses: revisit the cited guides once a method is confirmed.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Trigger the UFO random encounter. A video guide shows how: go to the marked spot in Kelly County after 2am, where a car sits at the roadside with its lights flickering. Head up the road and the UFO appears; speak to the stranger, then go back to her car to unlock the trophy.
steps: Go to Kelly County after 2am and find the roadside car with flickering lights.
Head up the road from the car until the UFO encounter begins.
Speak to the stranger, then return to her car — the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Honestly not yet confirmed. The description says to bowl targets over with a melee drive-by — a melee attack from a moving vehicle — and KeenGamer notes the precise method is still being confirmed. This entry does not invent a target count or location; try melee drive-bys on enemies and revisit the cited guide once a method is confirmed.
steps: The only confirmed hint is the description itself: a melee drive-by.
No target count, location or confirmed method has been published yet — revisit the cited guide once one is.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies, so this pairs with the robbery work for the 100% checklist — launder the takings as you go instead of sitting on them.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is cleaned.
Robberies for the 100% checklist (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 vaults) will supply the bills.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across the shops of Leonida. Push Square notes it is simply a matter of shopping — find shops on the map under Touch Pad, then Style — and the total adds up across every shop, so buy what the run needs anyway.
steps: Shop at any stores across Leonida; every purchase counts toward the $100,000 total.
Find shops on the map under Touch Pad, then Style (Push Square).
Weapons, clothes, vehicles and property upgrades all count — spend on things the run needs.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in the game. Garages also store the vehicles you register for On the Spot, so buy them as the money comes in from robberies and laundering.
steps: Find the garage properties for sale around Leonida.
Purchase all of them — the trophy pops with the last one.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Any 10 vehicles will do, so register the ones you drive most — and keep scanning new vehicles with WAiNK at the same time, since 200 are needed for the 100% checklist.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app and register a vehicle.
Repeat with 10 different vehicles.
Pair it with WAiNK scanning: every new vehicle found is progress toward 200 for 100%.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
